# v3.24-dev

## Fixed

- **Auto-created trainings no longer arrive pre-filled with values nobody chose.** When a student import finds a training title that isn't in the catalogue yet, it creates a placeholder entry in the amber **"needs attention"** list. Those entries were being shown with a Type, Product and Function already filled in — but the import only ever knows the training's *name*, so those three were invented (always `Certification`, always `Sales`, and whichever product type happened to sort first). The row looked reviewed and finished when nothing had been reviewed at all.

  All three now show as **Not set** until you pick them.

- **"Mark as Complete" could promote those invented values into the catalogue in one click**, without ever opening the entry. That button has been replaced: click **Edit**, choose the Type, Product and Function (or attach the entry to an existing Full Title to inherit them), then **Save & Complete**. Leaving any of the three unset reports what's missing and changes nothing, so an unreviewed entry can't slip into the catalogue by accident.

- **Failed saves in that list are no longer silent.** A rejected save looked exactly like a successful one; the reason is now shown above the table.

## Updated

- The training-data editing endpoint now validates Type and Function properly, returning a clear error instead of a generic server failure when given an unrecognised value.
